calls.statement:
SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS rows_all, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS ids_all, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS rows_cur, count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS ids_cur, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current AND marketing_consent) AS cur_consent, min(join_date), max(join_date), max(valid_from)
FROM dim_member m WHERE m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS total_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS ids, count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS cur_ids, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS cur_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE member_id IS NULL) AS null_ids, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_current, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_version_ids, (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store)) AS orphan_home
FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates) AS stg_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s JOIN dim_member d USING (member_key)) AS stg_keys_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE s.is_current AND s.member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.home_store_id AND valid_from = s.valid_from)) AS stg_current_not_matching,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE s.is_current AND s.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)) AS stg_current_tampere,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT max(valid_from) FROM dim_member) AS max_vf,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to <> DATE '9999-12-31') AS cur_with_end,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS noncur_open

calls.statement:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT m.member_id FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
  WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
), act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-05'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM t) AS members_tampere_home,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM t JOIN act USING (member_id)) AS active_12m,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=m.home_store_id AND s.is_current WHERE m.is_current AND s.city='Tampere' AND s.store_id<900 AND m.marketing_consent) AS consent
